title: Traditional Ukrainian Dumplings
description: A hearty Ukrainian dish made with crispy potato-filled dumplings. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and warm water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small pieces and roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of mashed potatoes in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the potatoes and press the edges together to seal.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the melted butter.
When the butter has melted, add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with your favorite toppings, such as sour cream or chives.
